payload.message:
JIRA sprint task allocation. Each agent chooses at most one micro-task (or skips). Maximize tasks completed, prefer higher-priority tasks, then minimize total cost. Avoid duplicate task selections and infeasible assignments.

NOTE: If environment.assignment_filling=true and an agent fails to assign a variable, the environment will fill any remaining unassigned variables with a uniform-random allowed assignment when producing final results.

This blackboard is a private communication channel.
Participants: Jeanene, Layla, Mona, Pauline, Sara, Shaunna

Availability 7.0, top skill testing 0.87, so both seem feasible; ISSUE-0002::review is my strongest candidate due to lower cost. All ISSUE-0001 options are very expensive for me. Unless someone else is much better suited, I currently intend to take ISSUE-0002::review in execution; ISSUE-0002::test is my backup. Please share intended claims to avoid duplicates.

Sara planning update: Availability 7.0, top skill ui-ux-design 0.69. ISSUE-0002::implement is effort 8.0 > availability 7.0, so likely infeasible for me. Mona already prefers ISSUE-0002::review at lower cost 7.44, so to avoid duplicate critical-review claims I currently lean toward ISSUE-0002::test as my preferred execution choice, with ISSUE-0001::triage as backup if another agent is better on 0002::test. Please share intentions on ISSUE-0002::test / ISSUE-0001::triage.

Given Mona prefers ISSUE-0002::review and Sara leans ISSUE-0002::test, I currently lean toward ISSUE-0001::triage as my preferred execution claim because it is cheap and avoids conflict; backups ISSUE-0001::review or ISSUE-0001::docs. If anyone is substantially better positioned for ISSUE-0001::triage, please say so and I can switch to review/docs.
